instruction: Remodel a hostel layout from the provided IFC. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png as the visual reference for the starting condition. Replace the starting hotel layout with a three-storey hostel layout and export the final IFC4 model to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. The final IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, three IfcBuildingStorey entities, twenty-one IfcSpace objects, twenty-four IfcWall elements, three IfcSlab elements, and one IfcStair. Name the spaces so they include at least twenty Bedroom spaces and one Lounge space, with one space named exactly Shared Lounge. The final export should not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcCurtainWall, IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. The init file is a remodel starting point and should not already be accepted as the final result. Other hostel planning details may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
